name: Saffron the Ruffled Cat
blurb: Saffron, a tawny-gold cat with a thick curly russet ruff and honey eyes, lounges in the white garden flowers like it's her stage.

name: Glimmer the Tawny Cat
blurb: Glimmer, a sleek tawny cat with a dark brown neck ruff and dark tail tip, watches the dusk sky glow in waves from the garden wall.

name: Dusky the Russet Ruff Cat
blurb: Dusky, a fluffy ginger-tan cat with a deep russet ruff, cream chin and gold eyes, curls up under the lit arbor for the firefly show.
